correctness.rationale: All Fourier eigenvalues are derived from the binary Krawtchouk generating function. In the four-cap case the quadratic factor R is bounded below by \(c(3m^2-21m+47/4)/24>0\) for \(m\ge7\), so the unique parity mode controls every p in (0,1]. The parity root is strictly monotone by positive integral derivatives. The exact Gram rank and all even-cap uniform asymptotic follow analytically. Finite checker output confirms small cases but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural clipped Hamming family models saturated finite dissimilarity. The result supplies a complete even-radius scale law for all fixed even caps, a sharp exact four-cap threshold in all dimensions at least eight, and the exact single-parity embedding-dimension drop. This contrasts qualitatively with the earlier three-cap middle-degree obstruction and is more than a table recomputation.
